"'''Last Night'''" is a song written by John Byron, [[Ashley Gorley]], [[Jacob Kasher Hindlin]], and [[Charlie Handsome|Ryan Vojtesak]]. It was recorded by American [[country music]] singer [[Morgan Wallen]], the third single from his 2023 album ''[[One Thing at a Time]]''.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.allaccess.com/top40-mainstream/cool-new-music | title=Login to All Access | Breaking Radio News and Free New Music }}</ref> The song peaked at number one on the ''[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]'' [[Hot Country Songs]] in February 2023.

For the week ending March 18, 2023, "Last Night" reached the top of the [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]], a first for Wallen. The last country song to reach the top spot was "[[All Too Well|All Too Well (10 Minute Version) (Taylor's Version) (From the Vault)]]" by [[Taylor Swift]] in 2021, and the last time a solo male artist did so was in 1981, with the song "[[I Love a Rainy Night]]" by [[Eddie Rabbitt]]. It spent 16 non-consecutive weeks at the top, the second most for a non-collaboration and tied for the third most of all time. According to ''[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]'', the song was the number one single for 2023, the third such single to have also hit number one on the ''Billboard'' country chart since 1959. The song was nominated for [[Grammy Award for Best Country Song|Best Country Song]] at the [[66th Annual Grammy Awards|66th Grammy Awards]].

"Last Night" is a song written by John Byron, Ashley Gorley, Jacob Kasher Hindlin, and Ryan Vojtesak. It was recorded by American country music singer Morgan Wallen, the third single from his 2023 album One Thing at a Time. The song peaked at number one on the Billboard Hot Country Songs in February 2023.

For the week ending March 18, 2023, "Last Night" reached the top of the Billboard Hot 100, a first for Wallen. The last country song to reach the top spot was "All Too Well (10 Minute Version) (Taylor's Version) (From the Vault)" by Taylor Swift in 2021, and the last time a solo male artist did so was in 1981, with the song "I Love a Rainy Night" by Eddie Rabbitt. It spent 16 non-consecutive weeks at the top, the second most for a non-collaboration and tied for the third most of all time. According to Billboard, the song was the number one single for 2023, the third such single to have also hit number one on the Billboard country chart since 1959. The song was nominated for Best Country Song at the 66th Grammy Awards.

sections.wikitext:
The song peaked at number one on the ''[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]'' [[Hot Country Songs]] charts dated February 13, 2023, ascending from a debut position of number seven one week prior. The same week, Wallen's prior singles "[[Thought You Should Know (Morgan Wallen song)|Thought You Should Know]]" and "[[You Proof]]" claimed the number two and three positions, while "[[I Wrote the Book (Morgan Wallen song)|I Wrote the Book]]" was at number 10.<ref>{{cite magazine | url=https://s3.amazonaws.com/bulletins.billboard.com/country/country_update_2023_0213.pdf | title=Billboard Country Update | magazine=[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]] | date=February 13, 2023 | access-date=February 13, 2023 | archive-date=February 15, 2023 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230215191238/http://s3.amazonaws.com/bulletins.billboard.com/country/country_update_2023_0213.pdf | url-status=dead }}</ref>

Following the release of ''One Thing at a Time'', "Last Night" ascended from number five to one on the [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]] dated March 18, 2023, becoming Wallen's first number one on the chart. The song achieved 47.5 million streams, 18,000 digital downloads sold, and a 10.8 million airplay audience. The same week, Wallen occupied 36 places on the Hot 100, the most of any artist, as well as five of the top 10 on the Hot 100.<ref>{{cite In July 2023, "Last Night" became the first song to accrue one billion on-demand streams in the United States in a single year.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://musicmayhemmagazine.com/morgan-wallens-last-night-makes-history-as-first-song-to-reach-1-billion-streams-in-2023/ |title=Morgan Wallen's "Last Night" Makes History As First Song To Reach 1 Billion Streams In 2023 |first=Andrew |last=Wendowski|date=July 7, 2023 |work=Music Mayhem}}</ref> On December 16, 2025, it was certified 12× Platinum by [[Recording Industry Association of America|RIAA]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Hahnen |first=Madison |date=2025-12-16 |title=JUST IN: Morgan Wallen Becomes RIAA Highest Certified Country Artist Of All Time |url=https://musicrow.com/2025/12/just-in-morgan-wallen-becomes-riaa-highest-certified-country-artist-of-all-time/ |access-date=2025-12-16 |website=MusicRow.com |language=en-US}}</ref>

The song peaked at number one on the Billboard Hot Country Songs charts dated February 13, 2023, ascending from a debut position of number seven one week prior. The same week, Wallen's prior singles "Thought You Should Know" and "You Proof" claimed the number two and three positions, while "I Wrote the Book" was at number 10.

Following the release of One Thing at a Time, "Last Night" ascended from number five to one on the Billboard Hot 100 dated March 18, 2023, becoming Wallen's first number one on the chart. The song achieved 47.5 million streams, 18,000 digital downloads sold, and a 10.8 million airplay audience. The same week, Wallen occupied 36 places on the Hot 100, the most of any artist, as well as five of the top 10 on the Hot 100. "Last Night" is also the first country song by a solo male to top the Hot 100 in over 42 years, following "I Love a Rainy Night" by Eddie Rabbitt (1981), and the first country song to top the chart since "All Too Well (10 Minute Version) (Taylor's Version) (From the Vault)" by Taylor Swift in November 2021. On the chart dated August 5, 2023, "Last Night" sat at number two between Jason Aldean's "Try That in a Small Town" and Luke Combs's "Fast Car" at numbers one and three, respectively, making it the first time in the Hot 100's history that the top three positions were all occupied by country artists. On the chart dated August 19, 2023, "Last Night" topped the Hot 100 for a 16th non-consecutive week, surpassing "As It Was" by Harry Styles as the longest running number one by a solo artist with no accompanying acts, as well as tying for the second longest run of all time. To date, it is the only single to have peaked at number one on the Billboard Hot 100 during six consecutive months.

In July 2023, "Last Night" became the first song to accrue one billion on-demand streams in the United States in a single year. On December 16, 2025, it was certified 12× Platinum by RIAA.

sections.heading: International
sections.wikitext: "Last Night" also had lengthy runs, particularly in the top-ten and top-50, on the [[Canadian Hot 100]],<ref name="CAN"/> [[ARIA Singles Chart]],<ref name="Australia"/> Ireland,<ref name=occpage/> and New Zealand.<ref name=NZchartsportal>{{cite web|url=https://charts.nz/showitem.asp?interpret=Morgan+Wallen&titel=Last+Night&cat=s|title=Morgan Wallen - Last Night|publisher=New Zealand Charts Portal|access-date=September 8, 2026}}</ref> The song spent six weeks at number one on the Canadian chart and eight weeks on the Australian,<ref name="Australia"/><ref name="CAN"/> while its one week at number two in New Zealand was below [[SZA]]'s "[[Kill Bill (song)|Kill Bill]]".<ref>{{cite web|url=https://charts.nz/weekchart.asp?year=2023&date=20230424&cat=s|title=Single Top 40|publisher=New Zealand Charts Portal|date=April 24, 2023|access-date=September 8, 2026}}</ref>
